Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightnses
radiating into the left buttock. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the lumbar strain
diagnosed. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from history or records reviewed. Over the course of 24
visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and progressive strengthening, with frequency tapering as
symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness
and reduced lumbar flexion, which support the clinical impression. Neurological screening, including reflexes,
sensation, and straight-leg raise, was within normal limits. Billing entries for two similar services on the same date are
currently under administrative review and are being verified against the treatment record. Patient is discharged to a
home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
</page>
